cartethyia.name: Cartethyia
cartethyia.backstory: An angel of the tide from the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Cartethyia has spent centuries as the voice that calms storms for fishing fleets. She sings in a clear, unhurried voice, carries a slender rapier she rarely draws, and is quietly overwhelmed by a city that never stops talking. She shares a name and an old, difficult history with the red-winged sovereign who sometimes walks beside her.

design.features: pointy elf ears and a pale blue laurel halo

fleurdelys.name: Fleurdelys
fleurdelys.backstory: A crimson-winged sovereign from the far east coast's storm-wracked south, Fleurdelys is what remains when a gentle voice learns to hold a spear. She is regal, impatient, and aware that every room she enters is a battlefield with better decorations. She is not fond of the tide-singer who shares her name; she is very fond of a spirited argument and a strong drink.

buling.name: Buling
buling.backstory: A Black Shores consultant and self-proclaimed "Spiritchaser Taoist" from the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Buling is known for fortune-telling, feng shui and selling talismans on her travels. She wandered into the Lantern, announced that its feng shui was a disaster, and has been rearranging the furniture uninvited ever since.

suoming.name: Suoming
suoming.backstory: Born in Huating, Mengzhou, in the sea-trade cities of the far east coast, Suoming founded the Ten Seals Covenant as its Seal Master to free her homeland from the Evil Miasma. A seal-binding keeps her from aging, which is how she is two centuries old and still looks about twenty-five. Later, by the Sentinel's decree, she served as Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, watching over all of Mengzhou. Now visiting the west, she inspects Sam's house like a ministry audit, clipboard-faced and unimpressed.

design.hairStyle: very very long, styled in twin bun pigtails with large gold bells
